ActionQueue: Queued background actions (sync jobs) — list, read, and patch status (Pending/Retry/InProgress/Success/Error).
Activity: Planned activities (work-order blocks): CRUD, filtering, unplanned/harvest-central blocks, hour logs, tags, forms, and per-activity materials/problems/operations/resources.
ActivityTemplate: Activity (work-order) templates — list, create, read, update, and their materials.
Asset: Asset list (equipment assigned to work orders).
Attachment: Attachments looked up by owning entity.
Attendance: Clock-in/out attendance: lists, detail, today, save/bulk save, approve/unapprove, breaks, shifts, reports, productivity and job stats.
AttendanceApprovals: Attendance adjustment approval requests — list, request, save/update (single and bulk), history. Routes are lowercase `/api/attendance/approvals`.
Auth: Sign-in (`/signin`, `/powerbi`). Tokens issued here do not work on QA — see SKILL.md Authentication.
Break: Break definitions — list, read, create, update.
Crop: Crops and crop varieties — list, read, dropdown list.
Cultivation: Cultivations (crop on a field for a season): CRUD, paginated/filtered lists, info, end cultivation, change crop/item.
DataImport: Bulk import helpers: fields per farm, activities per cultivation, field geo-coordinates, farm cultivations.
Dynamics365: Read a Dynamics 365 record by id.
ELKLog: ELK logs and API packet logs (integration monitoring).
Enum: Resolve a server enum by name (`GET /api/Enum/{name}`).
Farm: Farms (sites' farms): CRUD, NDVI, metadata per location, farm cultivation, side navigation (deprecated).
Field: Fields (plots): create, update, delete, coordinates, cultivations, activities on map, NDVI.
FileExport: Export a work order to a file.
Form: Inspection form templates and their input fields — CRUD, status toggles, submissions, field types.
Grower: Growers — list, all, read, create, update.
HarvestCentral: Harvest Central: harvest blocks and harvest tickets — create, update, delete, plan, link project, post.
HarvestId: Harvest IDs — CRUD, unallocated list, link/de-link.
HarvestTicket: Harvest tickets (legacy route) — CRUD and post tickets.
Hello: Diagnostics: `Echo` (liveness, works without a valid token), error/log tests, bulk test-data generators (mutating).
HierarchyLevel: Organisation hierarchy levels — CRUD, status, bulk save.
HierarchyNode: Organisation hierarchy nodes — CRUD, tree, bulk save.
HistoryLog: Entity change history — list and read.
IrrigationMethod: Irrigation methods — list, read, create, update.
IrrigationSource: Irrigation sources — list, read, create, update.
Job: Integration jobs — list per connection, update.
Location: Locations (Sites) — CRUD, resource's locations, tracking logs, all.
Map: Map layers: cultivation, work-order, and observation details (POST filters).
Material: Materials — CRUD, paginated lists, certified resources, attachments.
Message: Integration messages — list, payload, request/response, stats, retry, history.
Metadata: Lookup lists for dropdowns (112 GETs): crops, operations, materials, resources, statuses, units, enums, notification metadata, WMS fleets/drivers/trucks.
Notification: Notification placeholders, templates, event configs, and FCM device tokens.
Observation: Observations / points of interest — list, read, create, update.
Operation: Operations — CRUD, filtered and paginated lists, plan-change filter.
PermissioningModule: Flat list of permission modules (for role editing).
Resource: Resources (people/equipment) — CRUD, types, certified resources, paginated list, site reassignment.
Season: Seasons (crop years) — list, all, read, create, update.
Settings: Tenant settings: general, attendance, cloud functions, material filters, WO sequence, item-group mapping, Dynamics system.
SettingsMapTogglesConfig: Map toggle configuration — list, read, update (under `/api/Settings/SettingsMapTogglesConfig`).
Stage: Crop stages — CRUD and the operations attached to a stage.
User: Users — CRUD, enable/disable, role permissions, shift check, lookup by email, user settings.
UserGroup: User groups — CRUD and status toggle.
WMSIntegration: WMS integration: push fleets/drivers/trucks/trailer plates; harvest tickets — list, update, void, mark synced, attachments.
WorkOrder: Work orders: CRUD, detail/summary, status change, recall, end, sync to Dynamics, hour logs and change requests, progress, harvest picks and forecasts, validation.
WorkOrderInventory: Work-order inventory: list, meta, material dispatch/return (with validate).
WorkOrderLine: Work-order lines (blocks) — CRUD and material/hour-log/row history.
